messages:
Nina Park: Hey y'all — Nina here! Starting today as SWE on infra. I brought strong tea and a tiny succulent. Desk: 4B near the big window. Excited to meet you all :wave:
Kelly Li: Welcome Nina!! :tada: Desk buddies for coffee later? I'm Kelly (platform eng).
Omar Ziadeh: welcome! we have a morning tea crew at 10 in kitchen. ping me if you want a tour.
Dave R.: Hi Nina — Dave in infra ops. FYI badge + VPN steps in onboarding doc. LMK if you need access.
Marta (People Ops): Welcome Nina — orientation at 2pm, bring ID. Also quick pulse: snack preference? chocolate / fruit / salty — reply with emoji.
Nina Park: Thanks everyone! Chocolate please :chocolate_bar: Also does anyone have a spare plant pot? mine didn't survive the flight :cry:
Kelly Li: I have an extra pot! I'll drop it off 11:30. :seedling:
Omar Ziadeh: :coffee: tea + pastry run at 9:45, @Nina Park want anything? (I owe you a warm welcome gif) :grin:
DeployBot: Welcome message sent to #general with badge photo. :robot_face:
Dave R.: Desk 4B is next to me, I'll save you a power strip. ping me if monitor mounting needed.
Nina Park: Amazing, thank you all. See you at 10 (tea) and 2 (orientation). Also curious — is there a Redwood book club? :books:
Kelly Li: We do! #book-club channel. Next meetup is 3/15. I'll DM you details
